title: Lärare/Pedagog till vård- och omsorgsutbildning sökes omgående
description:
Lärare/Pedagog till vård- och omsorgsutbildning sökes omgående

Då förändringar skett i organisationen så söker vi nu omgående en pedagog till vår Vård- och omsorgsutbildning.

Tora Vega Folkhögskola

Tora Vega Folkhögskola startade i augusti 2025 sin första vård- och omsorgsutbildning och vi söker nu fler engagerade pedagog/lärare som vill vara med och fortsätta utveckla utbildningen tillsammans med oss. Vill du arbeta i en dynamisk bildnings- och utbildningsorganisation med 156 års erfarenhet av att bedriva utbildning?

Vi finns i Åkarp, Lund och Landskrona. Hos oss bidrar du varje dag till att ge våra studerande verktyg för att komma vidare i livet – samtidigt som du själv utvecklas i din yrkesroll.

Välkommen att bli en del av Tora Vega Folkhögskola!

Arbetsuppgifter och placering

Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med kollegor för att vidareutveckla vår vård- och omsorgsutbildning som öppnade i Åkarp hösten 2025.

I tjänsten ingår att:

    Undervisa studerande inom vård- och omsorgsutbildningen
    Vara mentor
    Planera, genomföra och följa upp undervisning
    Bedöma och dokumentera studerandes kunskapsutveckling
    Handleda i olika lärsituationer, både i skolan och i samband med APL (arbetsplatsförlagt lärande)
    Delta aktivt och drivande i utvecklingsarbete, både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor och skolledning
    Administrativa uppgifter

Som pedagog skapar du förutsättningar för en stimulerande lärande- och bildningsprocess. Du arbetar motiverande och relationsskapande och har förmåga att möta studerande utifrån deras individuella behov.

Du ingår i ett arbetslag där pedagoger med olika ämneskompetenser samverkar. Administrativa uppgifter är en naturlig del av tjänsten.

För att trivas hos oss är det viktigt att du delar vår bildningssyn och känner dig bekväm med flexibla utbildningsupplägg och en verksamhet i utveckling.

Arbetsplatsen är huvudsakligen i Åkarp, men undervisning och administrativa uppgifter i Lund och Landskrona kan förekomma. Vid behov kan undervisning även ske inom andra delar av vår utbildningsverksamhet.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker i första hand dig som är legitimerad yrkeslärare inom vård och omsorg.

Alternativt:

    Studerar kompletterande yrkeslärarutbildning inom vård och omsorg eller
    Är utbildad sjuksköterska eller undersköterska med relevant yrkeserfarenhet och avser att studera till yrkeslärare

Du har:

    Mycket god digital kompetens och vana att använda digitala verktyg och medier i undervisningen
    God förmåga att motivera, coacha och stödja studerande utifrån deras individuella förutsättningar
    Ett professionellt och respektfullt bemötande gentemot studerande och kollegor
    Förmåga och vilja att samarbeta i team

Mediterade:

    Gärna relevant arbetslivserfarenhet från sjukhus, vårdcentral eller akutsjukvård.
    Vi ser gärna att du har god kunskaper inom psykiatri, anatomi, funktionsnedsättning samt hälso- och sjukvård
    Erfarenhet av arbete inom gymnasieskola, vuxenutbildning och/eller folkhögskola

Du är pedagogiskt trygg, ser till helheten och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändringar. Du trivs i en miljö som ställer höga krav på flexibilitet, ansvarstagande, handlingskraft och social kompetens.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet – detta är avgörande för tjänsten.

Anställning

    Tillsvidareanställning, 80–100 %
    6 månaders provanställning
    Semestertjänst med differentierad undervisningstid

Om du blir aktuell för tjänsten ska du kunna uppvisa godkänt utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister.

Tillträde

Omgående

Sista ansökningsdatum

30 augusti 2026. Ansökan görs via Tora Vega Folkhögskolas webbsystem: https://toravega.se/lediga-tjanster/

Ange "Yrkeslärare Vård och omsorg"

OBS! Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning kan ske innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Ansökan ska innehålla personligt brev och meritförteckning.

Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post eller post.

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt all direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

Kontakt

Eduardo Gran Villanueva-Contreras

Skolchef/Rektor

📞 076-546 44 02

📧 eduardo@toravega.se

Matilda Persson Sjödell

Förstepedagog

📞 070-669 51 85

📧 matilda@toravega.se

Fackliga företrädare nås via växel: 040-464 400

Om Tora Vega Folkhögskola

Tora Vega Folkhögskola (tidigare Hvilan Folkhögskola) grundades 1868 och är Sveriges äldsta folkhögskola.

Vårt huvudcampus är beläget i Åkarp, och vi bedriver även utbildningsverksamhet i centrala Lund, centrala Landskrona samt på distans. Genom oss eller vår systerorganisation Tora Vega Akademi erbjuder vi även uppdragsutbildningar och projektverksamhet.

Varje år studerar cirka 700 deltagare hos oss. Många beskriver skolan som en plats där nya möjligheter och utmaningar öppnar vägen mot framtiden. Här får deltagarna verktyg att stärka sin livssituation och möjlighet att aktivt delta i samhällsutvecklingen.

Tora Vega är en religiöst och politiskt obunden, icke vinstdrivande ideell förening där mångfald, inkludering och alla människors lika värde står i centrum.

Läs mer på www.toravega.se (För verksamheten i Landskrona se även www.landskronafolkhogskola.se). Följ oss gärna på Facebook, Instagram, TikTok och LinkedIn.

title: Samordnare/mentor/lärare -yrkessvenska/vård/omsorg-Landskrona Folkhögskolor
description:
Samordnare, mentor och lärare (yrkessvenska/vård och omsorg) - Landskrona Folkhögskolor

Landskrona Folkhögskolor (ett samarbete mellan Tora Vega Folkhögskola och Östra Grevie folkhögskola)

Vill du vara med och bygga en ny utbildning som gör verklig skillnad?

Landskrona Folkhögskolor söker en engagerad och utvecklingsinriktad samordnare, mentor och lärare till vår nya språk- och yrkesförberedande utbildning och arbetsmarknadsinsats inom vård och omsorg.

Utbildningen/arbetsmarknadsinsats startar hösten 2026 och syftar till att ge deltagare med begränsade kunskaper i svenska möjlighet att utvecklas mot arbete eller vidare studier inom vård- och omsorgssektorn. Verksamheten genomförs i nära samarbete med Landskrona stad och andra samverkansparter.

Om oss

Landskrona Folkhögskolor etablerades våren 2026 genom ett samarbete mellan Sveriges äldsta folkhögskola, Tora Vega Folkhögskola, och Sveriges största folkhögskola, Östra Grevie folkhögskola. I nyrenoverade lokaler i centrala Landskrona bedriver vi Allmän kurs, Socialpedagogutbildning, Studiemotiverande folkhögskolekurs (SMF) samt olika utbildnings- och arbetsmarknadsinsatser. Vi förenar hög pedagogisk kvalitet med individfokus och ett starkt samhällsengagemang. Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med på en spännande utvecklingsresa och bidra till att bygga en utbildningsmiljö där deltagarnas utveckling, delaktighet och framtid står i centrum.

Om tjänsten

Detta är en bred och varierad tjänst där du får ett helhetsansvar för deltagarnas utveckling och för utbildningens praktiska genomförande. Du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i verksamheten och arbeta nära deltagare, kollegor, arbetsgivare och samverkansparter. Tjänsten kombinerar samordning, mentorskap, undervisning och arbetslivssamverkan. Du blir en viktig del i att skapa en utbildning som leder vidare till arbete eller fortsatta studier.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer bland annat att:

    samordna och utveckla utbildningens dagliga verksamhet
    vara mentor och lärare för deltagarna och följa deras individuella utveckling
    planera, genomföra och utvärdera undervisning
    undervisa i svenska som andraspråk, yrkessvenska och arbetslivsorienterade moment utifrån din kompetens
    integrera språkutveckling i utbildningens samtliga delar
    planera studiebesök, gästföreläsningar och praktiknära aktiviteter
    samverka med Arbetsförmedlingen, Landskrona stad, vård- och omsorgsverksamheter samt andra samarbetspartners
    arbeta med dokumentation, uppföljning och kvalitetssäkring
    bidra till verksamhetens och utbildningens fortsatta utveckling tillsammans med skolledningen.

Vi söker dig som

    har pedagogisk högskoleutbildning eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
    har erfarenhet av undervisning inom vuxenutbildning, folkhögskola, SFI eller svenska som andraspråk. Erfarenhet av vårdutbildningar är meriterande.
    har erfarenhet av arbete med personer som står långt från arbetsmarknaden eller befinner sig i en etableringsprocess
    har erfarenhet av motivationsskapande arbete och motiverande undervisning samt förmåga att inspirera, engagera och stötta deltagare mot studier, arbete och personlig utveckling
    har god förmåga att skapa struktur, bygga förtroendefulla relationer och skapa en trygg och inkluderande lärmiljö
    är van att arbeta självständigt, ta eget ansvar och samtidigt samarbeta med kollegor och externa samverkansparter
    har ett stort engagemang för folkbildning, integration, arbetsmarknadsfrågor och människors möjligheter att växa genom utbildning.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet, pedagogiskt ledarskap, samarbetsförmåga samt förmågan att skapa goda relationer med såväl deltagare och kollegor som externa samverkansparter.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du:

    är yrkeslärare inom vård och omsorg och/eller har erfarenhet eller god kunskap om vård- och omsorgsområdet
    har erfarenhet av projektledning eller utbildningssamordning
    har erfarenhet av samverkan med kommuner, Arbetsförmedlingen eller arbetsgivare
    har erfarenhet från folkhögskola eller annan vuxenutbildning.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och bygga upp en helt ny utbildning från grunden och bidra till att människor når egen försörjning och en hållbar väg in i arbetslivet. Du blir en del av två väl etablerade folkhögskolor med lång erfarenhet av folkbildning, integration, arbetsmarknadsinsatser och yrkesutbildning. Hos oss får du stor möjlighet att påverka verksamhetens utveckling och vara med och forma framtidens utbildningsinsatser i Landskrona.

Anställning

    Projektanställning på ett år, med goda möjligheter till förlängning.
    Heltid och semestertjänst
    Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
    Placeringsort: Landskrona.

Tillträde

Gärna omgående

Ansökan

Sista ansökningsdag är den 30 augusti 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Skicka ditt personliga brev och CV till:

📧 jobb@landskronafolkhogskolor.se Ange "Samordnare – Yrkessvenska/Vård och omsorg" i ämnesraden.

title: Principal Recruiter – FMCG & FoodTech
description:

I am seeking a recruiter to represent me in identifying and securing my next full-time career opportunity. The assignment involves identifying relevant companies and positions, engaging hiring managers and decision-makers, presenting my profile, and supporting the recruitment process through to successful placement.

Responsibilities

    Use existing networks and market knowledge to reach hiring managers, and decision-makers
    Identify suitable career opportunities within product, innovation, strategy, and commercial functions
    Provide market insight regarding companies, roles, and career positioning
    Support communication and relationship-building throughout the recruitment process

Background

Experience recruiting across Europe for commercially oriented roles within Food & Beverage, FMCG, Food Retail, and FoodTech is highly desirable. The ideal partner has a proven track record of recruiting for the following functions:

    Product Manager / Product Strategy
    Innovation Manager
    Brand Manager / Category Manager
    Commercial Strategy
    Business Development
    Strategy / Strategic Planning
    Consumer Insights
    Portfolio Management

Compensation

This is a flexible, success-based assignment. Compensation will be provided through a finder’s fee upon successful placement into a suitable role.

Application

Please provide a short overview of your recruitment background, relevant industry experience, and examples of companies or professional networks you can access.

title: Frisör med specialkompetens inom bröllop och evenemang
description:
Bolaget bedriver allt som hör frisöryrket till och hjälper våra kunder med olika behandlingar, såsom klippning, färgbehandling, styling, kundbemötande, service och konsultation. Vi är också kvalitetsinriktade och lägger stor vikt vid att skapa avancerade bruduppsättningar och brudmakeup som uppfyller våra kunders önskemål. Dessutom erbjuder vi försäljning av produkter som kompletterar våra tjänster. Bolaget är specialiserat på bruduppsättningar och brudmakeup inför bröllop.

Vi expanderar ständigt och söker nu en kreativ och engagerad frisör som vill bli en del av vår arbetsplats. För att verksamheten ska nå sina mål behöver vi skickliga frisörer med gedigna kunskaper inom frisöryrket och en passion för utveckling med en dokumenterad erfarenhet av bruduppsättningar, hårstyling och makeup anpassade till etiopiska bröllop och andra kulturella evenemang.

Eftersom vi strävar efter att alltid utvecklas, är vi särskilt engagerade i att lyfta vår expertis inom avancerade bruduppsättningar och brudmakeup. Vår huvudinriktning på bröllopsförberedelser, särskilt för etiopiska evenemang, gör oss till en unik aktör på marknaden. Vi letar därför efter frisörer som vill vara med på denna spännande resa och bidra till att göra vår verksamhet ännu bättre.

Vem är du då?

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för frisöryrket och dokumenterad yrkeserfarenhet. Du har god kommunikativ förmåga, är serviceinriktad och kan förstå kundernas önskemål samt utföra behandlingar med hög kvalitet. Du trivs med att arbeta i team men ansvarsfull. Du är motiverad för nya utmaningar och bidra salongens framgång.

Arbetsuppgifter:

Du kommer att arbeta i vår salong i Vårberg. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar klippning, hårstyling, avancerade bruduppsättningar, brudmakeup, styling av brudgum, enklare skönhetsbehandlingar, kundkonsultation och produktförsäljning. Du kommer även att planera och genomföra hår- och makeupbehandlingar inför etiopiska bröllop och andra kulturella evenemang.

Vi söker dig som är engagerad och glad som vill jobba med oss i vårt fantastiska team i Vårberg. Vi vill kunna erbjuda våra kunder allt det bästa. Vi ser gärna att du är ordningsam, serviceinriktad och har goda kommunikationsförmåga.

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och lägger avgörande vikt vid yrkeskompetens, erfarenhet och personlig lämplighet.

Dina egenskaper och bakgrund:

    Goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska. Kunskaper i amhariska och/eller tigrinja är meriterande eftersom en stor del av kundkontakten sker med amharisk- eller tigrinjaspråkiga kunder.
    Minst två års dokumenterad yrkeserfarenhet som frisör.
    Avslutad frisörutbildning och yrkesbevis inom frisöryrket eller annan dokumenterad utbildning och kompetens som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
    Utföra klippningar av hög kvalitet
    Utföra avancerade bruduppsättningar, hårstyling och brudmakeup.
    Ge professionell kundservice och rådgivning samt arbeta med produktförsäljning.
    Ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av hårstyling och makeup anpassade till etiopiska bröllop och andra kulturella evenemang.
    Kunna arbeta dagtid, kvällstid samt lördagar och söndagar enligt arbetsschema.

title: Budbilsförare För TAD Transport AB
description:
Som distributionsförare hos TAD Transport AB arbetar du med paketleveranser och upphämtningar i samarbete med våra partners, bland annat Airmee och Linas Matkasse.

Arbetet innebär att du börjar ditt arbetspass på ett lager där du lastar ditt fordon med paket och leveranser. Därefter kör du ut till olika adresser enligt en planerad rutt för att leverera paket till privatpersoner.

Leveranserna kan bestå av paket från olika företag och e-handelsaktörer, till exempel matleveranser, e-handelsprodukter och apoteksvaror. I arbetet ingår även att hämta upp paket från privatpersoner, exempelvis försändelser som ska skickas via Sellpy.

Arbetet kräver att du är noggrann, serviceinriktad och kan arbeta självständigt. Du planerar och följer din leveransrutt via en mobilapplikation och ansvarar för att leveranser och upphämtningar sker på ett effektivt och professionellt sätt.

title: Senior Data Analyst
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in helping H&M make better decisions through data. You will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, engineers and fellow data professionals to turn complex questions into actionable insights that drive measurable business impact.

You will lead analytical initiatives from problem definition through delivery, combining technical expertise with strong business understanding and stakeholder engagement.

    Lead end-to-end analytical projects and initiatives that support strategic business goals
    Translate complex business challenges into structured analytical approaches and recommendations
    Define, measure and follow up on KPIs to support product, business and customer outcomes
    Explore and analyse large datasets to identify opportunities, risks and trends
    Deliver insights and recommendations that influence decision-making at different levels of the organisation
    Partner closely with stakeholders to understand needs, challenge assumptions and identify new data opportunities
    Contribute to the development of data products, reporting solutions and analytical frameworks
    Promote best practices in analytics, data storytelling and insight generation
    Mentor and support other analysts while contributing to a strong data community

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You will collaborate with a broad network of stakeholders across H&M, including Product Managers, Business Experts, Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, business leaders and other analysts.

As a trusted partner, you will help teams across functions use data to make informed decisions and deliver value for customers and colleagues.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    Several years of experience in data analytics, business analytics or a similar field
    Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets
    Experience with Python, R or similar analytical programming languages
    Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI
    Strong knowledge of statistics and analytical methodologies
    Experience translating business requirements into analytical solutions
    Experience defining and measuring KPIs and performance metrics
    Experience leading analytical initiatives and working independently in complex environments
    A degree in Statistics, Engineering, Business, Economics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

And people who are…

    Curious and motivated by solving challenging business problems
    Strong communicators who can adapt their message to both technical and non-technical audiences
    Comfortable influencing and advising stakeholders at different organisational levels
    Proactive and able to identify opportunities before they are formally requested

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

    The opportunity to solve meaningful business challenges using data and analytics
    A collaborative environment where your insights can influence strategic decisions
    Access to modern data platforms, tools and technologies
    Opportunities to learn, grow and develop your career within H&M Group
    A culture built on collaboration, inclusion, innovation and continuous improvement

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things: our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it's our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Pizzabutiken söker medarbetare
description:
Vi på Pizzabutiken söker en ny kollega till vårt köksteam! Huvuduppgiften i rollen är att tillaga smashburgare, men arbetet inkluderar även andra rätter från vår meny, liksom enklare köksuppgifter och service i kassan. Arbetet är varierat och omfattar både dagtid, kvällar och helger.

Vi är ett mindre, växande matkoncept som fokuserar på kvalitet, smaker och personlig service. Vår specialitet är smashburgare, gjorda från grunden med bra råvaror och mycket kärlek, men vi serverar även andra populära rätter. Nu söker vi dig som vill bli en del av vårt team och växa tillsammans med oss.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att inkludera:

    Tillagning av smashburgare

    Förberedning och tillagning av andra rätter

    Arbete i kassan och kontakt med gäster

    Städning och löpande kökssysslor

    Bidra till god stämning och teamwork i köket

Vi söker dig som:

    Är noggrann, ansvarsfull och har ett matintresse

    Trivs med att jobba i högt tempo

    Är serviceinriktad och gillar att jobba med människor

    Har tidigare erfarenhet från kök (meriterande, men inte ett krav)

    Har B-körkort (meriterande, men inget krav)

Vi erbjuder:

    Ett jobb med fokus på matlagning och utveckling

    Upplärning på plats, du behöver inte kunna allt från början

    En trivsam arbetsmiljö med engagerade kollegor

    Möjlighet till både deltid och heltid, enligt överenskommelse

Skicka din ansökan till antoni.gatsaras@gmail.com.

Upplärning startar omgående, och tjänsten tillsätts enligt överenskommelse.

Tack för visat intresse, vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Application Specialist  Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Junior)
description:
Application Specialist – Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Junior)

About the role

As an Application Specialist, you will support the implementation and continuous improvement of Microsoft Dynamics 365 together with experienced colleagues. You will combine your technical interest with an understanding of business processes and work closely with business users, Product Owners and project team members to deliver successful D365 implementations. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with 1–2 years of experience who wants to develop within Dynamics 365 in an international environment.

Responsibilities

    Support the implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 together with your squad and Implementation Manager.
    Configure D365 modules according to defined business requirements and project scope.
    Support integration activities together with senior team members.
    Document market-specific configurations and implementation decisions.
    Collaborate closely with business users to understand requirements and provide support.
    Prepare and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
    Participate in cutover planning and go-live activities.
    Deliver end-user training and support the "train-the-trainer" approach.
    Support data migration activities, including data preparation, validation and loading using standard D365 tools.
    Contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
    Ensure solutions are documented according to project standards.

Who you are

    Team-oriented and collaborative.
    Curious, proactive and eager to learn.
    Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
    Structured, responsible and solution-oriented.
    Analytical with good problem-solving skills.
    Interested in business processes and ERP systems.
    Comfortable working in an agile and international environment.

Qualifications

    1–2 years of experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or another ERP platform.
    Experience from implementation projects, application support or business system administration is considered an advantage.
    Basic understanding of one or more business process areas such as:
    Procure to Pay
    Order to Cash
    Record to Report
    Fixed Assets
    Procurement & Sourcing
    Supply Chain Management
    Basic experience with data migration or data management in D365 (DMF) is an advantage.
    Experience with integrations or ISV solutions is considered a plus but is not required.
    Knowledge of Microsoft localizations or regulatory compliance is an advantage.
    Experience working in agile teams is beneficial.

Nice to have

Experience with one or more of the following is considered an advantage, but not a requirement:

    ExFlow
    Treasury Automation Suite
    Comarch
    Integrations using Azure or reusable APIs

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

title: Electrical and Communication Engineering
description:
Role Overview:

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the Electrical discipline cover other construction areas as required. This includes ensuring compliance with design specifications, technical standards, and project requirements while aligning with cost, schedule, and safety objectives. Electrical Engineer closely collaborates with Plant Unit Project Managers, Construction Managers, and other cross-functional Technical Project Managers to ensure seamless integration of Electrical tasks.

Key responsibilities include managing contractors and suppliers, monitoring progress and costs, mitigating technical risks, electrical and communication design, and ensuring quality and documentation standards are met. The role also supports procurement with technical input, evaluates change requests, and drives continuous improvement by applying lessons learned.

Key Responsibilities:

· Manage all tasks related to the technical discipline, ensuring compliance with design specifications, technical standards, and project requirements.

· Ensure that all work aligns with design-to-cost and schedule objectives.

· Work with Plant Unit Project Managers and Construction Managers to integrate discipline-specific work into the overall plant unit, ensuring smooth coordination and alignment with plant unit goals.

· Provide updates on discipline-specific progress to the Technical Discipline Manager and escalate issues when necessary.

· Oversee the work of contractors and suppliers related to their discipline, ensuring that work is completed on time and to the required quality standards.

· Identify technical risks and work with both the Technical Discipline Manager and Plant Unit Project Manager to resolve issues and mitigate risks.

· Ensure all technical work is properly documented and that progress is reported regularly to the Plant Unit Project Manager and Technical Discipline Manager. Align with suppliers and contractors

· Making standard documents as per project requirements and as per standards

· Familiar with electrical engineering software like ETAP, SPF, and DIALUX.

· Familiar with SS EN Standards such as SS 4364000, SS EN 50522, SS EN 50110 Elsäkerhetsverket (ELSÄK-FS)

· In-depth knowledge of MV/LV power distribution systems and electrical equipment.

· Pre-commissioning for electrical equipment such as panels, transformers, motors, and so on.

· Familiar with the design and installation of switchgear, Transformers, cables, and bus ducts.

· Factory Acceptance Test witness in international companies.

· Strong knowledge of workplace safety & experience in a broad range of safety procedures.

· Ensure that all technical aspects align with project goals, including safety, budget, scope, and schedule.

· Provide expertise and guidance on discipline-specific methodologies and best practices.

· Support procurement with technical input during contract negotiations.

· Review and approve all deliverables within the discipline to ensure quality standards and specifications are met.

· Assess resource needs to ensure that project goals are met.

· Adjust team activities as necessary to meet project timelines and objectives.

· Identify areas for process improvements within the discipline.

· Implement lessons learned from past projects to enhance future performance.

Competencies and experience:

· Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.

· Minimum of 8 years of experience within the design, construction, and installation of Electrical systems.

· Good knowledge of the technical aspects of Electrical systems within industrial projects.

· Strong leadership and management skills.

· Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

· Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

· Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

· Possibility to start the assignment at short notice.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and cover letter to info@nordicteq.com with the subject line “Electrical and Communication Application – [Your Name]”.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Ready to take ownership of your own sales area and drive growth in a fast-moving industry? ePARK is growing and is now looking for a proactive and business-driven Sales Specialist. In this role, you will take full responsibility for prospecting, customer development, and driving growth within your assigned region.

As part of ASSA ABLOY and the SKIDATA Group, you will join a supportive and forward-thinking team in Gothenburg or Stockholm, Sweden. You will play a key role in expanding our payment and parking solutions, with the freedom to develop your career and make a meaningful impact.

What you would do as our Sales Specialist

You would actively work with digital service sales within payment and parking solutions.

The role includes 8–10 physical and digital customer meetings per week and requires a self-driven, structured approach, along with the ability to create business opportunities through dialogue, needs analysis, and long-term relationship building.

You would collaborate closely with our Customer Success Managers, who are responsible for operations and ongoing account management. In this role, you would work with a diverse customer base, including operators and landowners, property companies, arenas and large facilities, security providers, and municipalities.

You would also:

Identify and acquire new customers within your region, contributing to overall user growth.

Build and manage partnerships by negotiating agreements and tailoring ePARK’s solutions to meet customer needs and ensure profitability.

Oversee the correct setup of signage and service implementation to secure strong app coverage in your area.

Promote and drive the adoption of ePARK’s solutions among B2B customers and end users to increase service usage.

Own the overall performance of your territory, including growth, coverage, and results, and ensure targets are met (a valid driving license is required).

The skills and experience you need

We are looking for someone who:

Has strong experience in B2B service sales, including prospecting and building long-term customer relationships.

Is comfortable working independently and driving results against clearly defined targets and KPIs.

Thrives in a high-paced environment with frequent customer interactions and meetings.

Has an interest in, or experience with, digital tools and improving operational efficiency.

Is self-motivated, structured, and driven by achieving results and continuous improvement.

Has fluency in Swedish and English.

What we offer

We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:  

Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.

A competitive salary and benefits package.

A dynamic and inclusive work environment.

The chance to make a meaningful impact in attracting and retaining top talent.

We review applications regularly, so don't wait

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here.

To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Alexandra Kymäläinen, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at alexandra.kymalainen@assaabloy.com

Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening will need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be a subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.

Let’s create a safer and more open world - together!  

To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com

title: Lokalvårdare i privata bostäder - Hemfrid Västerås
description:
We are looking for new home cleaners in Västerås. Are you our next star? 🌟

Your profile

We love making our customers’ everyday lives easier – and so should you. We are looking for someone who likes to work independently and is driven by quality and customer service. You are punctual and responsible, with an eye for details and a positive attitude.

About the role

As a home cleaner at Hemfrid, you are responsible for cleaning our customers’ homes to the highest quality. Your mission is always to provide the best service possible. You work independently and are responsible for your clients’ satisfaction.

Your work tasks include, among others:


    Vacuuming and dusting.
    Mopping floors and cleaning surfaces.
    Strengthening, folding, and washing clothes.
    Changing bedsheets and making the bed.
    Give the customer’s home that little extra touch.

You should:


    Have previous experience from a service profession.
    Speak and understand basic Swedish or English.
    Be able to work flexible hours, Monday – Friday, between 8 – 17.
    Have a valid drivers license and access to your own car.

It is a strong merit if you have worked as a home cleaner, housekeeper, or equivalent before.



We offer

Our goal is clear – we want to be the best employer in the industry. We believe our employees are the heart of the company, and we are dedicated to providing good working conditions.

Among others, we offer:


    Fixed salary every month
    A permanent position with a 50-75 % employment rate.
    Collective agreement and favorable terms of employment.
    Liability insurance, health insurance, and pension insurance.
    Wellness allowance.
    Training in home cleaning, with a focus on your development.
    Great career opportunities and growth within Hemfrid.
    Free mobile subscription.
    One of Sweden’s greatest teams of colleagues from all over the world. 🙌

About Hemfrid

Hemfrid is Sweden's leading provider of home services. We help our customers with cleaning, laundry, ironing, moving, gardening, and more. By working as a team and providing easy access to first-class home services, we unlock people's quality of life.

Our process

After completing the application, you will be contacted by the HR department regarding the recruitment process for your application.

As part of our recruitment process, we always do a background check. You need to have a Swedish personal number or a coordination number to be eligible for this position.

Are you ready to unlock people's quality of life? Great! So are we. We look forward to your application.

Welcome to Hemfrid!



Vi letar efter nya hemstädare till Västerås. Är du vår nästa stjärna? 🌟

Din profil

Vi älskar att göra våra kunders vardag enklare – det borde du också göra. Vi söker efter någon som tycker om att arbeta självständigt och som drivs av kvalitet och kundservice. Du är punktlig och ansvarstagande, med ett öga för detaljer och en positiv inställning.

Om rollen

Som hemstädare på Hemfrid ansvarar du för att städa våra kunders hem med högsta kvalitet. Ditt uppdrag är att alltid erbjuda bästa möjliga service. Du arbetar självständigt och är ansvarig för att säkerställa att dina kunder är nöjda.

Dina arbetsuppgifter består bland annat av:


    Dammsugning och dammtorkning.
    Moppning och rengöring av ytor.
    Strykning, vikning och tvätta kläder.
    Byta lakan och bädda.
    Ge det där lilla extra till kundens hem.

Du bör:


    Ha tidigare erfarenhet från ett serviceyrke.
    Tala och förstå grundläggande svenska eller engelska.
    Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar, måndag – fredag, mellan 8 – 17.
    Ha ett giltigt körkort och tillgång till egen bil.  

Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska.

Vi erbjuder

Vårt mål är tydligt – vi vill vara branschens bästa arbetsgivare. Vi tror att våra anställda är företagets hjärta, och vi är dedikerade till att erbjuda bra arbetsförhållanden.

Bland annat erbjuder vi:


    Samma fasta lön varje månad
    En tillsvidareanställning med 50- 75 % sysselsättningsgrad.
    Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor
    Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring och pensionsförsäkring.
    Friskvårdsbidrag.
    Utbildning inom hemstädning, med fokus på din utveckling.
    Goda möjligheter att utvecklas och växa inom Hemfrid.
    Gratis mobilabonnemang.
    Ett av Sveriges härligaste team med kollegor från hela världen. 🙌



Om Hemfrid

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör för tjänster i hemmet. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, tvätt, strykning, flytt, trädgårdsarbete och mycket mer. Genom att arbeta som ett team och ge våra kunder enkel tillgång till våra toppklassiga tjänster förbättrar vi deras livskvalitet.

Vår process

Efter genomförd ansökan kommer du att bli kontaktad av HR- avdelningen angående rekryteringsprocessen för din ansökan.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller. För att vara kvalificerad för den här tjänsten behöver du ha ett svenskt personnummer eller ett samordningsnummer.

Är du redo att förbättra människors livskvalitet? Bra! Det är vi också. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Välkommen till Hemfrid!

title: Städare hos Premium kunder – Hemfrid Stockholm
description:
HEMFRID SÖKER STÄDARE HOS PREMIUMKUNDER – EN EXKLUSIV ROLL INOM HEMSERVICE ✨

Vill du arbeta i en serviceinriktad roll där kvalitet, ansvar och kundupplevelse står i centrum? Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande företag inom hushållsnära tjänster och erbjuder våra kunder professionell hjälp inom bland annat städning, organisering, tvätt, matlagning och familjeservice.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kan inkludera:

    

Professionell hemstädning och organisering

    

Tvätt, strykning och garderobsplanering

    

Förberedelse av måltider och enklare matlagning

    

Barnpassning och stöd till familjen i vardagen

    

Planering och hjälp inför aktiviteter eller tillställningar i hemmet

    

Inköp, ärenden och koordinering av hushållets behov

Vi söker dig som:

    

Har flera års erfarenhet inom hemservice, housekeeping, hemstädning eller liknande arbete

    

Är självgående, ansvarsfull och serviceinriktad

    

Har öga för detaljer och tycker om att skapa ordning och struktur

    

Är diskret och professionell i mötet med kunder

    

Trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och kan hantera flera saker samtidigt

    

Har erfarenhet av matlagning och gärna ett intresse för mat och service

    

Talar och förstår grundläggande svenska eller engelska

    

Kan arbeta vardagar mellan kl. 08.00–17.00

    

Har B-körkort (egen bil är meriterande)

title: Student? Work part-time from home as Technical Support!
description:
Are you an IT or tech student with at least two years left of your studies? Looking for a flexible role that matches your education? Join us to gain hands-on experience in technical support, customer service, and problem solving!

About the role

Envirotainer provides temperature-controlled container leasing solutions for the transportation of temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products. The Operations department includes Customer Service, Logistics, Damage Control, Global Service Network, and Reliability & Cold Chain Services, working together to ensure customers receive the right containers at the right time while supporting successful shipments.

As part of the Customer Service team, you will be the first point of contact for customers, providing high-quality support and helping deliver an excellent customer experience throughout the entire shipment process.

The role: In this role, you will be the link between Envirotainer, its customers, and partners, providing first-line support via email and helping resolve questions related to products, services, and basic technical issues. You will manage customer cases while ensuring a high level of service and customer satisfaction.

As customer support is available 24/7, you will work two weekend shifts per month (00:00–12:00 or 12:00–00:00) with on-call duty. You may also occasionally work during global public holidays. Your monthly schedule will vary, with a minimum of four paid hours per shift. More details will be provided during the recruitment process.

Introduction for the role will be held after summer, daytime on site.

Work tasks

    Responsible for the incoming customer cases, phone calls and e-mails  
    Troubleshooting guiding for customers  
    Hand over tasks to the full time staff that will help you solve the problems when the weekdays starts

We are looking for

    You have minimum 2 years left on your post-secondary education with an alignment towards IT or Tech
    Excellent English communication skills – verbal and written, as this is the language you will communicate in
    A great interest and good knowledge in IT and computers

As a person, you are:

    Flexible
    Solution oriented
    Fearless
    Take initative

Other information

    Start: August
    Work extent: Part time, weekend-shifts and stand-by during global official holidays
    Location: Flexible, from home
    Other: Introduction for the role will be held after summer, during office hours 8-17 on site

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Drug Product Specialist – Consulting Assignment at AstraZeneca, Södertälje
description:
Job description

About the Role

Are you passionate about working at the intersection of biological science and commercial manufacturing? On behalf of AstraZeneca, Randstad Life Sciences is looking for an ambitious and experienced Drug Product Specialist (Process Scientist) to join the Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T) team in Södertälje.

This is a full-time consulting assignment where you will be employed by Randstad Life Sciences and work on-site at AstraZeneca's facility in Södertälje.

You will be responsible for the scientific and technical aspects of new product introductions, technology transfers, and commercial manufacturing support within drug product processes (e.g., formulation, aseptic filling, lyophilization, and visual inspection).

Key Responsibilities

    Technology Transfer: Lead scientific aspects in new product introductions and technology transfers for drug product processes.
    Process Robustness: Ensure commercial process robustness through risk assessments, technical studies, data analysis, and scientific recommendations.
    Validation & Maintenance: Lead process performance qualification (PPQ) and contribute to product maintenance.
    Operational Support: Provide product-specific technical support to ongoing commercial operations.
    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Engineering, QA, QC, Supply Chain, and global teams.
    Compliance: Contribute to GMP documentation and regulatory submissions.

Requirements

Essential Requirements

    Education: MSc or higher in biotechnology, chemical engineering, pharmacy, or another relevant life science/engineering discipline.
    Experience: 3+ years of experience in biologics, pharmaceutical development, technology transfer, or commercial manufacturing, with a focus on drug products.
    Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience in one or more areas: formulation, aseptic filling, lyophilization, or visual inspection.
    Language: Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.

Desirable Qualifications

    PhD or advanced specialization in a relevant field.
    Previous experience at AstraZeneca.
    Experience working in global and cross-functional teams.
    Knowledge of single-use systems, isolator technology, or finished pack manufacturing.
    Experience with project management, digital transformation, or AI applications in manufacturing.

Soft Skills & Profile

    Organized, analytical, adaptable, and detail-oriented.
    Strong teamwork abilities combined with the confidence to work independently.
    Proactive mindset—takes initiative to drive progress rather than waiting for instructions.

Important Information

    Consulting Details: Full-time contract assignment through Randstad Life Sciences based on-site at AstraZeneca in Södertälje.
    Background Check: Selected candidates must successfully complete a standard background check and drug/alcohol screening prior to employment.

How to Apply

Please submit your application and CV in English as soon as possible. Applications are evaluated continuously!



Responsibilities

    Technology Transfer & Product Introduction: Lead scientific aspects in new product introductions and technology transfers for drug product processes.
    Process Robustness & Quality: Ensure commercial process robustness through process understanding, risk assessments, technical studies, data analysis, and sound scientific recommendations.
    Validation & Maintenance: Lead process validation / process performance qualification and contribute to product maintenance.
    Operational Support: Provide product-specific scientific and technical support to ongoing commercial operations.
    Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development of ways of working, digital templates, and risk-based approaches to enable consistency and efficiency across MS&T activities.
    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Operations, Engineering, QA, QC, Supply Chain, global teams, development functions, and external partners.
    Compliance: Contribute to GMP documentation and regulatory submissions.




Qualifications

    PhD or advanced specialization in a relevant field.
    Previous experience working at AstraZeneca.
    Proven experience working in global and cross-functional teams.
    Knowledge of single-use systems, isolator technology, or finished pack manufacturing.
    Previous project management experience.
    Understanding of digital transformation and AI applications in manufacturing, process monitoring, or technical support activities.

Soft Skills & Personal Profile

    Highly organized, analytical, adaptable, and detail-oriented.
    Strong teamwork capabilities combined with the confidence to work independently.
    Demonstrates initiative, takes a proactive approach to challenges, and actively drives progress rather than waiting for instructions or resisting change.




About the company



Randstad

På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential.

Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

title: Manager Issue Resolution - Packaging
description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary

We are looking for an Issue Resolution Manager, Packaging, to lead the resolution of complex technical issues involving filling equipment, packaging lines, and packaging material across the Mid Europe market.

This is a senior individual contributor role with market-level responsibility and no direct reports. You will also provide governance for the wider portfolio of packaging technical issues in the market.

The preferred locations are Austria (Vienna), Germany (Hochheim), Switzerland ( Glattbrugg), Italy (Rubiera), or Sweden (Lund). Other Tetra Pak locations within Europe may be considered, including a home-based arrangement where appropriate.

Applicants must already have the right to work in the proposed country of employment. International relocation to Europe is not available for this position.

What you will do

As Issue Resolution Manager, Packaging, you will:



    Lead the containment, structured root cause analysis, sustainable elimination of technical root causes and final closure of complex packaging technical issues and Accidents and Incidents assigned or transferred to the Issue Resolution team. This includes:
    Establishing and coordinating cross-functional issue resolution teams, engaging the technical resources required and managing activities and action plans.
    Identifying risks of issue expansion and coordinating the deployment of existing solutions or the development of new ones.
    Maintaining clear and timely communication with customers, market leadership, account teams, and technical stakeholders.
    Ensuring that investigations, root causes, corrective actions, and supporting documentation meet the required standards before approving issues for closure.
    Capturing and deploying lessons learned and best practices to prevent recurrence.
    Govern the portfolio of packaging technical issues across the market, ensuring appropriate ownership, action plans, and progress reviews.
    Review and approve the appropriate Cost of Poor Quality categories for issue-related costs, within the applicable authorization limits.
    Drive local Service Desk adoption, issue visibility, data quality, process compliance, and consistent routing of technical issues.
    Monitor issue resolution performance and provide insights during market performance reviews.

We believe you have

    At least five years of relevant experience with Tetra Pak or comparable packaging equipment, packaging material, technical service, or issue resolution.
    Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations and structured root cause analysis.
    The ability to coordinate cross-functional teams without formal reporting authority.
    Strong project coordination, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
    Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings to customers, specialists, and senior leaders.
    The ability to manage difficult customer situations and conflicting expectations while remaining calm, objective, and decisive under pressure.
    Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
    Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time, occasionally at short notice.

It is an advantage if you have:

    Advanced certification in Tetra Pak Problem Solving Methodology, Kepner-Tregoe, World Class Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Lean, or another recognized problem solving methodology.
    Experience with technical issue management systems.
    Professional proficiency in German.
    Experience facilitating problem-solving workshops or developing others' technical capability.

We Offer You

    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements



Apply Now

If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.

This job posting expires on 2026-08-22.

To know more about the position contact hiring manager, Andrea Nicoli .

If you have any questions about your application, please contact Rita Necsei at rita.necsei@tetrapak.com.



For those who apply from Sweden, for trade union information, contact Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 and Sveriges Ingenjörer Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533



Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

title: Hardware Engineer Softstarter
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to: R&D Unit Lead.

Are you interested in shaping the next generation of high-quality, scalable and easy configurable softstarters within ABB’s Electrification business area? Would you like to apply your expertise in a challenging and fascinating environment in a global and diverse company?

Then, join our team of highly motivated engineers as a R&D engineer for electronics hardware development, and contribute to the foundations of next-generation ABB products. You will maintain our active product portfolio, contribute creative ideas to product realization initiatives and propose innovative development projects addressing customer specific requirements. We provide an agile, dynamic workplace and you will be part of a cross-functional agile team embedded in a global network of collaborating teams.

We expect that you show a high motivation, hands-on attitude as well as taking initiative to come up with new ideas that tackle today’s challenges.

Your role and responsibilities

    You design, develop, and implement analog and digital circuits from concept phase to serial production.
    Your tasks include creation of schematics and definition of constraints for PCB layout, definition of verification specifications and execution of verification activities of your designs by simulation and prototype testing, as well as documentation and handover of the developed technologies with subsequent implementation support to production engineering.
    You collaborate closely with product owner, product management, system architects and software developers to breakdown market requirements to product requirements for hardware.
    You monitor technology developments and product technologies to identify technical drivers for R&D projects, supported by your thorough understanding of key business drivers for ABB’s products and solutions.
    You participate in internal and external networks to expand your knowledge of your area of expertise.
    You take responsibility for hardware development activities, as (senior) member, including risk identification, alignment with targets, and close coordination with suppliers and other functions (e.g. product management).
    You contribute to discussions of intellectual property and secure patent rights for ABB by driving the IP creation.

Qualifications for the role

    M.Sc. or B.Sc degree in Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems or comparable field
    At least 5 years of experience in development of electronics within embedded systems as a hardware design engineer in an industrial context
    Sound knowledge in designing electronic circuits, circuit diagrams, and working with simulation tools
    Experience in testing and validation of prototypes in a laboratory. Proven experience in working with voltage levels up to ~1kV would be considered a plus
    Knowledge in EMC compatible design would be considered a plus
    Willingness to travel internationally (<5%)
    Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential; Swedish language skills are beneficial but not a prerequisite.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Recruiting Manager: Stephan Wildermuth. Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Linda Nyman, +46 70 233 30 88, Unionen: Hannah Norén, +46 706 34 03 46, Ledarna: Lenny Larsson, +46 706 32 85 47. Talent Partner: Medina Jakupovic, +46 72 464 46 98, will answer your questions about the recruitment process.

We look forward to reading your application in PDF-format. Last day to apply is 28 august. We review applications on an ongoing basis, which means that the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We kindly request no direct contact from staffing or recruitment agencies, or vendors offering additional job advertising services.

Contribute to a shared vision. This is where ideas become reality, progress is made, and we shape the world together. Run what Runs the World.

We value people from diverse backgrounds. Could this be your next step? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see how our technology is making an impact on the world.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Construction Manager
description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

Placement: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Construction Manager for our Construction team. In this role you will report to our Head of Site Execution and work within our Project Delivery function. The team is responsible for executing construction activities on site, ensuring safe, high-quality, and on-schedule delivery across multiple work fronts.

As Construction Manager, you will drive day-to-day field execution within your assigned area. You will coordinate contractors, ensure work readiness, and maintain momentum on site while resolving issues and keeping teams aligned with project priorities.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Drive daily construction activities to ensure alignment with safety, quality, and schedule targets
    Maintain short-term lookahead plans (3–6 weeks) to secure readiness of materials, resources, and access
    Coordinate with EPCM and contractors to track progress, constraints, and execution priorities
    Validate work readiness, ensuring permits, drawings, materials, and resources are in place
    Identify and resolve field issues, clashes, and productivity barriers
    Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with safety and quality standards
    Participate in coordination meetings, site walkdowns, and SIMOPS planning
    Provide clear updates on progress, risks, and upcoming needs to the Area Construction Manager

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

    Experience in construction execution within large-scale industrial or infrastructure projects
    Strong understanding of field coordination, sequencing, and construction practices
    Experience working with contractors, EPCM, and multiple work fronts on site
    Ability to manage short-term planning and lookahead scheduling
    Solid knowledge of safety standards, work readiness processes, and quality requirements
    Strong communication and coordination skills across teams and stakeholders
    Ability to solve problems and make decisions in a fast-paced environment
    A proactive and hands-on approach with strong presence on site

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies - bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders - thanks to the 500+ amazing people who work here.

As a Data Engineer at Sambla Group you will play a key role in building and maintaining the systems that power data-driven decision making across the company. You'll join a central Data Platform team, and work closely with an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager, contributing to everything from reliable data pipelines to enabling self-serve analytics and putting data to work in our operational tools.

We're building a modern, AI-native data platform, and we're looking for someone who doesn't just adapt to new tooling but actively drives how we adopt it. That means using AI-assisted development in your day-to-day work, exploring where LLMs and intelligent automation can make our platform smarter, and helping set the standard for how the team works with these tools going forward.

You will work with modern cloud-native technologies on GCP - including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Build and Artifact Registry - alongside tools like DBT, Prefect and Terraform.

What you'll work on:

    Design, build and maintain data pipelines and integrations (streaming, batch, API-based) that feed our data products
    Develop and maintain our Data Warehouse and contribute to data platform improvements
    Ensure data quality, data governance and GDPR compliance
    Architect scalable and secure solutions in GCP and BigQuery
    Use AI tooling to accelerate development and explore where it can add value across our data work
    Collaborate with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams

Must have:

    At least 3 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role
    Strong Python skills (e.g. Polars, Flask/FastAPI or similar)
    Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex joins
    Hands-on experience with GCP or AWS, preferably GCP
    Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
    Ability to manage and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have:

    Experience with dbt and data modelling concepts (dimensional modelling, SCD etc.)
    Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI or similar)
    Experience with observability, monitoring and alerting for data systems
    Background in fintech or financial data
    Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues
    Ability to communicate confidently in Swedish

We might be a little different from most companies. Instead of defining personal values, we’ve built a shared way of working - a rhythm that guides how we collaborate, support our customers, and move forward together. We call it Drive & Jive - a shared rhythm that creates momentum through direction, collaboration, and human connection.

Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Sweden, as we do not provide visa sponsorship or relocation assistance for this position.

title: Mechanical Testing Engineer (Hands-On Role)
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Step into a hands-on role where you drive the future of materials reliability and safety. Join our dynamic team of 15 dedicated materials professionals and take the lead in planning and executing advanced mechanical and thermo-mechanical tests. You’ll collaborate closely with R&D and engineering teams, ensuring our test rigs and equipment are always ready for the next challenge. Imagine yourself evaluating test results with precision, supporting structural safety work, and making a real impact on the performance of critical components. If you’re passionate about innovation and eager to grow in a diverse, inclusive environment, this is your opportunity to shine.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    You perform advanced mechanical and thermo-mechanical tests, including Thermo-Mechanical Fatigue (TMF), Tensile, Impact, and Low Cycle Fatigue (LCF) testing.
    You evaluate and interpret test results, delivering clear and accurate insights.
    You plan and coordinate testing activities in partnership with R&D and engineering teams.
    You support and organize maintenance of mechanical test rigs and related equipment.
    You contribute to structural safety work, including risk assessments and integrity evaluations, and follow up with metallographic analysis when needed.

What You Bring

    You hold a Master’s degree (MSc) in Materials Technology or a closely related field, with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
    You have hands-on expertise with mechanical testing equipment and procedures, and are familiar with TMF, LCF, and metallographic techniques.
    You demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
    You are fluent in English; Swedish language skills are a plus.
    You bring experience with MATLAB and Python for data analysis, and proficiency in Microsoft Office for documentation and reporting.

About the Team

You’ll join a collaborative and inclusive group of 15 materials technicians, engineers, and experts who are passionate about advancing materials and structural integrity. Our team thrives on diversity, drawing strength from a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We work closely together to deliver high-impact projects, support each other’s growth, and maintain a stimulating environment with cutting-edge testing capabilities. Inclusion and belonging are at the heart of our culture, and we believe that every voice matters.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 301372 not later than 2026-08-21.

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.
