title: Associate in GC & IMM
employer: HSBC Continental Europe Bank, Sweden Filial
description:
Business:                         CIB

Location:                            Stockholm, Sweden



Role Purpose

As an Associate in GC & IMM, your main responsibilities will include:

    Supporting one or more Global Relationship Bankers on a defined portfolio of clients within Nordics Banking
    Collaborating with others across GC & IMM in order to manage the clients’ global relationships
    Origination: Identifying marketing opportunities, undertaking appropriate analysis and preparation of proposals, presentations and pitches for new products and services
    Execution: interacting with clients and various product teams in order to ensure smooth execution in a timely manner
    Client engagement: establishing strong relationship with the portfolio of clients
    Financial Analysis: Developing an understanding of clients’ financials in order to assess the capital markets needs and the credit strengths / weaknesses
    Client Materials: Assisting in the preparation of presentations and other materials for clients
    Sector knowledge: Keeping up to date with the markets and the sector developments to support business development, portfolio management and credit risk assessment
    Collaborating with product and country teams
    Portfolio management / HSBC Strategy: understanding GC & IMM internal return hurdles and identifying opportunities to reduce Risk Weighted Assets to enhance relationship returns



Customers / Stakeholders        

Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets - First and foremost, a resource for the Strategic Innovation Investments senior investment professionals.

Portfolio companies – work with our existing and Target client base to develop strategic relevance with HSBC and value-add from HSBC

Internal businesses – work with internal business champions to develop strategic ties to our clients



Leadership & Teamwork

Support achievement of the HSBC vision, Values, goals and culture in personal behaviour, actions and decision making.

Take personal responsibility for understanding and agreeing performance expectations, completing the necessary mandatory training and developing the levels of capability and competence needed to be effective in the role.

Contribute to team development, effectiveness and success by sharing knowledge and good practice, working collaboratively with others to create a productive, diverse and supportive working environment.



Operational Effectiveness & Control

Suggest ideas and contribute to implementing actions that will improve customer service, quality or the way teams and individuals work together.

Adhere to HSBC policy, procedures and control requirements applicable to day-to-day working, exceptional and project activities, and raise any concerns about actual or potential issues promptly, in line with reporting and escalation procedures.

Continuously monitor relevant management information, gather information from Banking sources to assess potential impacts and identify risks, necessary changes and business opportunities.

Apply Banking policies, procedures, practices and standards to their allocated tasks, taking responsibility for their own actions, to ensure the achievement of high levels of quality, effective risk management and regulatory compliance.



Role Context

Management of Risk

The jobholder will ensure the fair treatment of our customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation.

This will be achieved by consistently displaying the behaviours that form part of the HSBC Values and culture and adhering to HSBC risk policies and procedures, including notification and escalation of any concerns and taking required action in relation to points raised by audit and/or external regulators.

The jobholder is responsible for managing and mitigating operational risks in their day to day operations. In executing these responsibilities, the Group has adopted risk management and internal control structure referred to as the ‘Three Lines of Defence’. The jobholder should ensure they understand their position within the Three Lines of Defence, and act accordingly in line with operational risk policy, escalating in a timely manner where they are unsure of actions required.

Through the implementation the Global AML, Sanctions and ABC Policies, supporting Guidance, and Line of Business Procedures the jobholder will make informed decisions in accordance with the core principles of HSBC's Financial Crime Risk Appetite.

The following statement is only for roles with core responsibilities in Operational Risk Management (Risk Owner, Control Owner, Risk Steward, BRCM, and Operational Risk Function

The jobholder has responsibility for overseeing and ensuring that Operational risks are managed in accordance with the Group Standards Manual, Risk FIM, & relevant guidelines & standards. The jobholder should comply with the detailed expectations and responsibilities for their core role in operational risk management through ensuring all actions take account of operational risks, and through using the Operational Risk Management Framework appropriately to manage those risks.

This will be achieved by:

Continuously reassessing risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.

Ensuring all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring, addressing areas of concern in conjunction with Risk and relevant line colleagues, and also by ensuring that actions resulting from points raised by internal or external audits, and external regulators, are correctly implemented in a timely fashion.



Observation of Internal Controls

The jobholder will adhere to, and be able to demonstrate adherence to, internal controls and will implement the Group compliance policy by adhering to all relevant processes/procedures.

The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.

The following statement is only for roles with managerial or specific Compliance responsibilities

The jobholder will implement measures to contain compliance risk across the business area. This will be achieved by liaising with Compliance department about business initiatives at the earliest opportunity. Also and when applicable, by ensuring adequate resources are in place and training is provided, fostering a compliance culture and optimising relations with regulators.



Candidate requirements:

    Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills
    Ability to undertake in depth review of industry, competitors, clients and products and provide a high quality analysis of credit risk
    Strong financial analysis capability
    Experience in developing marketing materials (pitch books)
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
    Understanding of HSBC Group and products
    High levels of motivation and strong work ethic
    Demonstrated capacity to build a network of contacts, both internal and external, in the context of interactions with colleagues and clients
    A strong understanding of the financial markets
    The position requires a self-confident person who is highly motivated and reliable, with strong team spirit
    Strong negotiation and presentation skills

title: Senior Plattformsspecialist inom Kafka och Confluent
description:

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en miljö där gemensamma integrationsplattformar är en viktig del av koncernens informationsförsörjning. Här finns redan etablerade lösningar med Confluent Platform och Red Hat AMQ Broker i Red Hat OpenShift, och nu ligger fokus på att vidareutveckla Kafka-plattformen samt utvärdera hur Confluent Cloud kan komplettera det befintliga plattformserbjudandet.

Rollen spänner över implementation, vidareutveckling och förvaltning, men också över hur plattformen upplevs av utvecklingsteamen. En viktig del är också integration med en intern utvecklarportal baserad på Backstage, så att utvecklare får en gemensam ingång till dokumentation, tjänster och funktioner. Krav

    Flerårig erfarenhet av implementation, konfiguration och förvaltning av Confluent Platform i produktionsmiljö.
    Praktisk erfarenhet av Confluent Cloud och dess tjänster.
    Djup kompetens inom Apache Kafka och Confluents plattformskomponenter, exempelvis Kafka Brokers, Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Cluster Linking, RBAC och ACL.

    Du arbetar självgående och strukturerat, samarbetar väl med utvecklingsteam och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap.

title: Postdoctor in translational mucosal biology
description:
We are currently seeking a candidate for a postdoctoral position in colorectal cancer (CRC) research. The project will explore the role of goblet cell-intrinsic mucosal defence systems in determining susceptibility to CRC.

The candidate will join a newly established Wallenberg Centre for Molecular and Translational Medicine (WCMTM) at the University of Gothenburg (https://wcmtm.gu.se/). As part of this venture, Dr. George Birchenough has established his research group (https://www.birchenoughlab.org/) at the Department of Medical Biochemistry & Cell Biology at the University of Gothenburg. The group works towards a better understanding of how mucosal defence systems control our interactions with the environment, how those systems fail in disease and how they might be prophylactically or therapeutically targeted.

The group is part of a large network of researchers at Gothenburg University, most importantly the Mucin Biology Groups cluster (http://www.medkem.gu.se/mucinbiology/) that currently includes over 30 researchers working at the forefront of mucosal biology. The candidate will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts in multiple experimental methods that work within the cluster, as well as more widely with other local and national groups within the WCMTM network.

Subject area

Translational Mucosal Biology

Subject area description

Our mucosal surfaces are the interface between the environment and our tissues. Their physiological functions are critical, but necessitate constant exposure of living cells to a vast collection of microbial lifeforms that includes many opportunistic and obligate pathogens. As a result, our mucosa has evolved multiple defensive systems that allow them to endure in this environment, and failure of these systems is often linked to development of acute and chronic disease. Consequently, understanding the development and regulation of these systems is key to understanding the pathoaetiology of mucosal disease and how they can be prevented or treated.

Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most frequent and lethal types of cancer, and is especially prevalent in nations with a high human development index, indicating that factors associated with a modern, Westernized lifestyle are linked to CRC development. Most cases of CRC result from spontaneous mutations rather than heritable oncogenic mutations, and dysregulated interactions between the intestinal microbiota and immune system are implicated in tumorigenesis. Goblet cell-intrinsic defence systems, such as the mucus layer and sentinel goblet cells normally control host-microbiota interactions, but we have recently found that these systems are highly susceptible to environmental alterations caused by exposure to a Western-style diet. Thus, disruption of goblet cell-dependent functions may have a causal relationship with CRC development.

By combining data from pre-clinical mouse models with analysis of samples from healthy and CRC patients, we hope to develop a better understanding of how goblet cell functions contribute to CRC susceptibility and develop new approaches to prevent CRC development.

Duties

The successful candidate will be expected to work extensively with pre-clinical mouse models and human tissues acquired during routine surgery. The candidate will be encouraged and expected to conduct their experimental research in an independent manner and to make significant contributions to project planning. The candidate will also actively contribute to the local research environment at the Mucin Biology Groups and engage in interactions with collaborators and other groups belonging to the WCMTM network. If necessary, the candidate may also be asked to assist in the supervision of Masters or PhD students.

Eligibility

The eligibility criteria for employing teaching staff are set out in Chapter 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance and in the Appointment Procedure for Teaching Posts at the University of Gothenburg.

To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.

In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area.  

Assessment criteria

Applications will be judged primarily on evidence of relevant scientific skills. The applicant must provide evidence of a PhD in a relevant area of research and have demonstrable skills in both written and spoken English. Previous experience working with animal models is essential. Any previous experience in microscopy, mass spectrometry, organoid culture, flow cytometry, microbiology, bioinformatics or in vivo disease modelling will be considered as merits in support of an application. Eligible applicants will be asked to partake in an interview and present their previous research. Great emphasis will be placed on the candidate’s personal suitability for the position and clear interest in the subject area.

Regulations for the evaluation of qualifications for academic positions are given in Chapter 4, Section 3 - 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance.

Employment

The employment is full time and temporary, two years with the possibility of one year's extension, with placement at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.



Contact information

If you have any questions about the position, please contact George Birchenough, senior lecturer. E-mail: george.birchenough@gu.se



Application

Submit your application via the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button.

The application should contain:

    A cover letter giving a brief description of previous research experience, and a motivation to why you are applying
    A CV including a list of publications
    Proof of completed PhD
    Contact details of at least two references

Vi kommer att ta oss an nya tekniker inom bearbetning och värmebehandling, utöka vår montering och göra vårt tekniska labb redo för att testa och utveckla nya, större produkter. Vi passar också på att modernisera vår materialhantering. Vi har påbörjat en efterlängtad resa och hoppas att du är rätt person att följa med!

Din missionSom Produktionsledare får du en nyckelroll i produktionsledningen och ansvarar för att leda vårt team inom maskinbearbetning. Tillsammans säkerställer ni ett effektivt, hållbart och flexibelt produktionsflöde. Du rapporterar till Produktionschef och är en aktiv del av Produktionens ledningsgrupp, där ni tillsammans skapar produkter och team i världsklass.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat och inkluderande team där samarbete, öppenhet och utveckling är centrala värderingar. Vi arbetar nära varandra över funktionella gränser och tar tillvara på både idéer och insikter från våra medarbetare. Här får du en verklig möjlighet att påverka och bidra till ett säkert, hållbart och effektivt produktionsflöde.

I rollen ansvarar du för ett team om totalt cirka 25 medarbetare i produktionsavsnittet maskinbearbetning. Som ledare ansvarar du för att leda och fördela arbetet mot uppsatta mål samt för att utveckla dina medarbetare genom bland annat medarbetarsamtal, kompetensutveckling och ett aktivt arbetsmiljöarbete. En viktig del av ditt uppdrag är också att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö och en stark sammanhållning i gruppen.

Placering och resorDenna position är placerad i Kalmar, Sverige. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten.

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.

Ansökan och kontaktI den här rekryteringsprocessen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-16. För frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen eller ansökan vänligen kontakta: Maria Tedsjö, Rekryteringsspecialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com.För frågor om tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Lars Björk, acting Production Manager, lars.bjork@epiroc.com



Profile description:

Din profilFör att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område och flera års erfarenhet av ledande arbete i en dynamisk produktionsmiljö. Du har god förståelse för produktionsprocesser gärna med teknisk kompetens.Du har arbetslivserfarenhet från industrin och behärskar svenska flytande samt har goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.



Som person är du en trygg och närvarande ledare som skapar engagemang genom förtroende, förståelse och delaktighet. Du har förmågan att coacha både individer och team mot gemensamma mål och ser ständiga förbättringar som en naturlig del av vardagen. Du är lösningsorienterad, flexibel och har lätt för att samarbeta, bygga relationer och kommunicera tydligt – även när tempot är högt och förutsättningarna förändras.



Vi värdesätter stort om du har ett intresse för digitalisering och förbättringsarbete samt en vilja att driva utveckling tillsammans med ditt team. Hos oss får du möjlighet att ta ett tydligt ledarskap, påverka arbetssätt och vara med och accelerera transformationen av vår produktion.



Våra ledarskapsförväntningarPå Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare är inspiratörer, pådrivare och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som går före med gott exempel och har modet att utmana det etablerade. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare aktivt främjar säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald, samtidigt som de sätter medarbetarnas välmående och kontinuerliga utveckling i fokus. Vi söker dig som har modet att tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst at MSD
description:
MSD Sweden is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to play a critical role in driving data-driven decision-making across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly analytical professional to work at the intersection of commercial strategy, market intelligence, customer analytics, and business performance. The role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders across local Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Finance, and regional and global teams to deliver actionable insights that support growth, enhanced customer engagement, and strategic decision-making.

The Business Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for analyzing market, customer, and competitive data to identify opportunities and trends that inform business strategy. The role will lead the development and maintenance of dashboards, reporting solutions, and centralized data platforms that provide stakeholders with timely and meaningful insights. In addition, the position will support product launches, sales force effectiveness initiatives, omnichannel performance analysis, and forecasting activities through advanced analytics and predictive modeling.

Acting as MSD Sweden's local Data & Analytics point of contact, the successful candidate will drive the adoption of analytics capabilities and help build data literacy across the organization. The role requires strong analytical skills, expertise in business intelligence and visualization tools, and the ability to communicate complex findings to a diverse range of stakeholders.

Success in this position will depend on the ability to lead complex projects, influence cross-functional teams, and translate data into actionable recommendations that support MSD Sweden's commercial and organizational objectives.

title: Test Engineer to the Production Team
description:
Scienta Omicron is a leading provider of instruments for surface science and nanotechnology. From its technology centers in Uppsala and Taunusstein, the company develops and manufactures high end systems for electron spectroscopy, scanning probe microscopy and thin film deposition in ultra-high vacuum

Scienta Omicron’s solutions are used by top universities, research institutes and industrial R&D labs worldwide to develop new materials for batteries, quantum technologies, next generation electronics, solar cells and advanced sensors. The technologies have supported several Nobel Prize winning research projects and are available as standard modular systems, “Materials Innovation Platforms” and tailored concepts for specific research needs.

Beyond instruments, Scienta Omicron builds long term partnerships through project planning, system design, equipment training, applications support and upgrades, across more than 30 experimental techniques. This combination of technology and support helps complex research infrastructure deliver value over many years.

We are now adding a new colleague to our Production Team based in Uppsala, Sweden. Our Production Team covers a wide range of functions including instrument assembly, testing, purchasing and managing logistics. This role is a great opportunity to be part of a growing high-tech company, in which you will have a profound influence in delivering world-leading scientific instruments. Our industry is highly international with customers based at Research Agencies and Universities around the world.

This position is responsible for part of the final testing of our instruments before they are delivered to our customers worldwide. Some of the instruments that we produce in Uppsala are the hemispherical photoelectron analyzers DA20, DA30, DFS30, HiPP 3, EW4000, Argus CU and the photon sources SX300, DSX400 and VUV5k.

Your Profile

·      PhD in physics or similar field

·      Experience in using Photo Electron Spectroscopy equipment, and Ultra High Vacuum (UHV) technology

·      Knowledge of instrument testing and production

·      Good understanding of complex technical parts

·      Hands on experience of building UHV systems

·      Proactive and creative problem-solving skills

·      Fluent in business English (verbal and written)

·      Ambition to learn Swedish (if not native)

·      Drive, energy and result oriented team player attributes

The workplace is located at Danmarksgatan 22, Uppsala, Sweden.

For more information about the position please contact: Johan Pettersson, Production Manager +46767667788.

We will review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis.

title: FM Category Lead (Energy & Utilities)
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

Are you interested in shaping how energy and utilities are managed at a global scale? We are looking for a FM Category Lead within Energy & Utilities to join our Global Facilities Management team.



In this role, you will lead H&M Group’s global energy and utilities agenda, driving energy performance, cost efficiency, and sustainability goals through strategy, governance, supplier collaboration, and scalable energy-saving initiatives across brands and markets

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As FM Category Lead within Energy and Utilities, you will provide global category leadership by setting the direction for how H&M Group manages energy consumption, utilities costs and energy-related performance across markets. You will develop strategies, standards, tools, and ways of working that support energy reduction, cost optimisation, and long-term asset performance.

You will act as a global subject-matter expert, supporting markets with guidance, best practice, and implementation of energy-efficient solutions. This includes working with energy data, KPIs, business cases, supplier input and market performance follow-up to identify opportunities, drive improvements and enable clear decision-making.

If you are motivated by the idea of combining technical understanding, sustainability impact and global stakeholder influence, this role offers a strong opportunity to make your mark. It will suit you if you enjoy translating complex energy and utilities topics into clear actions, building alignment across markets and functions, and driving initiatives from strategy to implementation

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

    Define and drive the global Energy & Utilities strategy across brands and markets
    Set energy, cost, and sustainability targets, KPIs, and performance standards
    Identify and scale energy-efficient and cost-effective solutions across the portfolio
    Establish global standards, guidelines, and tools for energy management and installations
    Ensure accurate data, reporting, and performance tracking across markets
    Develop frameworks for business cases, investment planning, and asset performance
    Drive and monitor global energy initiatives, identifying risks and improvement opportunities
    Support markets with energy procurement, vendor evaluations, and regulatory insights
    Strengthen energy management capabilities through training, knowledge sharing, and cross-functional collaboration
    Monitor industry trends, technologies, and regulations to drive continuous improvement and sustainability outcomes

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    At least 3-5 years experience in energy management, utilities optimisation or building energy systems
    A bachelor’s degree within Facilities Management, Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Property Management, or equivalent
    Proven experience setting and implementing energy strategies, preferably across multiple sites, markets, or regions
    Experience identifying and implementing energy-efficient solutions, technical improvements, and consumption reduction initiatives
    Experience working with HVAC systems, building automation, lightning systems, and energy monitoring tools  
    Strong understanding of performance follow-up, KPI steering and cost management for energy and utilities consumption
    Experience working cross-functionally with a wide range of stakeholders

And people who are…

    Analytical and structured, with the ability to balance strategic and operational perspectives
    Confident communicators who can influence and align stakeholders across markets and functions  
    Proactive and solution-oriented, comfortable leading initiatives from idea to implementation
    Collaborative and supportive, with a strong focus on knowledge sharing and capability building  
    Motivated by sustainability, responsible energy management, and the opportunity to contribute to long-term energy reduction  

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a full-time permanent position based in our Head Office in Stockholm. This role reports to the Head of Construction & Facilities. If your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your application at your earliest convenience. Please note that we will review applications and interview on a rolling basis.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.  

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

title: Technical Product Manager - Fixed term
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact-on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



We are looking for a new colleague to join our Technical Product Management team within BU Separation Technologies, for a fixed-term period of six months, with the possibility of extension.

As Technical Product Manager (TPM), you will be responsible for stainless steel separators used in Life Science applications within the Food & Pharma industry. You will maintain and oversee the technical specifications and construction files for your product range, ensuring they remain up-to-date and compliant.

A key focus of this position is understanding and interpreting compliance requirements for life science products. You will work closely with colleagues in both the Technical Product Management team and the Life Science program.

This is a key position in our team. For the right candidate, there may also be opportunities to lead and coordinate activities for the Food & Pharma maintenance team. This includes for example, weekly meetings focused on daily activities related to separators, collaborating with TPMs and designers, and leading weekly Change Request Board (CRB) meetings.

Who are you?
You are customer focused, and service minded, and you administrate multiple tasks in a high pace environment unchallenged. You work well in project teams. Quality improvement work is a known and natural way of working for you. Furthermore, to succeed in this role, you have:

    

Strong social and communication skills

    

Ability to anticipate consequences of improvements and deviation for a range of machines and/or another department's

    

Focus on timely deliveries and quality

    

Ability to communicate complex matters both orally and in writing

    

Technical orientation with commercial mindset

    

Ability to lead technical investigations



What you know
You have a degree in engineering and several years of relevant work experience. Knowledge of life science processes and requirements, or experience in the industry, is highly valued.

Additionally, you have:

    

Good understanding of technical specifications

    

Knowledge of separation technology and system functionality

    

Experience with design and production

    

Ability to work independently and make decisions

    

Good command of English both spoken and written

We offer a challenging position in an open and friendly environment where we work together and help each other to develop and create value for our customers. Your work will have a true impact on Alfa Laval's future success.

title: Vorstandsmandat Digitale Transformation
description:
Vorstandsmandat Digitale Transformation (Ehrenamt)  
Wir suchen per 1\. Januar 2027 eine engagierte und empathische Persönlichkeit für ein  
Vorstandsmandat Digitale Transformation (Ehrenamt)  
Das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Kanton Zürich erfüllt vor Ort wichtige humanitäre Aufgaben in den Bereichen Unterstützung im Alltag, Bildung und Migration/soziale Integration.  
Über uns Seit über 125 Jahren setzen wir uns im Kanton Zürich für mehr Menschlichkeit ein. Mit unseren Mitarbeitenden und über 2'400 Freiwilligen unterstützen wir Menschen im Alltag, fördern soziale Integration und stärken Gesundheit, Selbstbestimmung und Bildung. Unsere Arbeit orientiert sich an den Rotkreuz\-Grundsätzen, den Bedürfnissen der Bevölkerung und den gesellschaftlichen Entwicklungen im gesamten Kanton Zürich. Gemeinsam mit der öffentlichen Hand und Partnerorganisationen schaffen wir verlässliche und wirkungsorientierte Angebote, die dort helfen, wo Entlastung, Orientierung oder soziale Teilhabe fehlen.  
Die digitale Transformation verändert auch den Non\-Profit\-Sektor grundlegend. Neue Technologien, künstliche Intelligenz, steigende Anforderungen an Datenschutz und Cybersicherheit sowie veränderte Erwartungen von Spender:innen, Freiwilligen und Anspruchsgruppen stellen Organisationen vor strategische Entscheidungen mit langfristiger Wirkung. Um diese Entwicklungen vorausschauend, verantwortungsvoll und im Einklang mit unserem humanitären Auftrag zu gestalten, suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die digitale Chancen und Risiken einordnen kann und den Vorstand und die Geschäftsleitung mit ihrer Expertise bei zukunftsweisenden Fragestellungen begleitet.  
Deine Wirkung im VorstandAls ehrenamtliches Vorstandsmitglied „Digitale Transformation“ bringst du deine Perspektive dort ein, wo Weichen gestellt werden. Deine Wirkung zeigt sich insbesondere in folgenden Beiträgen:  
Strategische Einordnung technologischer Entwicklungen mit Blick auf Chancen, Risiken und langfristige Relevanz  
Einbringen digitaler Perspektiven in richtungsweisende Entscheidungen des Vorstands  
Sparring auf Augenhöhe für die Geschäftsleitung bei Fragen rund um Digitalisierung, KI und verantwortungsvolle Innovation  
Kritische Begleitung digitaler Investitionen mit Fokus auf Wirkung, Sicherheit und Nachhaltigkeit  
Verbindung von technologischer Machbarkeit, ethischer Verantwortung und humanitärem Auftrag  
Setzen von Impulsen und Mitprägen des Kurses für eine zukunftsgerichtete Organisation  
Gezielte Mitwirkung in Arbeitsgruppen und Projekten dort, wo deine digitale Expertise einen konkreten Mehrwert für Vorstand, Geschäftsleitung und Organisation schafft  
Was du mitbringst  
Erfahrung in der Begleitung oder Führung digitaler Transformationsprozesse bildet die Grundlage für diese Rolle. Hinzu kommen strategische Urteilskraft und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technologische Themen so einzuordnen, dass ein gemischtes Gremium fundiert entscheiden kann.  
Du verstehst, warum IT\-Sicherheit, Reputationsschutz und das Vertrauen von Spender:innen in einer gemeinnützigen Organisation untrennbar verbunden sind und was das für den Umgang mit neuen Technologien wie KI bedeutet.  
Ethische Fragestellungen sind für dich kein Beiwerk, sondern Teil der strategischen Beurteilung.  
Du verfügst über ein relevantes Netzwerk im Technologie\- und Digitalumfeld, welches du aktiv einbringst.  
Erfahrung in strategischen Gremien oder vergleichbare Führungsverantwortung ist von Vorteil.  
Ebenso wichtig ist die Identifikation mit den Rotkreuz\-Grundsätzen und die Bereitschaft, dich vertieft in den Kontext einer humanitären, spendenfinanzierten Organisation einzudenken.  
Erfahrung im NPO\-Umfeld ist willkommen. Entscheidend sind jedoch Haltung, Urteilskraft und echtes Interesse an unserem Auftrag.  
Was dich erwartet Das Ehrenamt steht bei uns im Zentrum: Als Vorstandsmitglied übernimmst du Verantwortung, bringst deine Expertise ein und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung des SRK Kanton Zürich aktiv mit. Als eigenständiger, unabhängiger Kantonalverband tragen wir volle Entscheidungsverantwortung. Wer in unserem Vorstand sitzt, gestaltet mit.  
Du arbeitest mit einem kompetenzorientierten Gremium zusammen, welches deine Expertise nimmt und aktiv bei strategischen Fragen ebenso wie in Arbeitsgruppen oder Projekten einbindet, in denen dein digitales Know\-how besonders gefragt ist. title: Data Engineer - Analytics Platform
description:
Data Engineer \- Analytics Platform (m/f/d)  
Level of employment: 80\-100%  
Working place: Allschwil and Home\- Office  
For 26 years, Medgate has been bringing doctors directly to patients 24/7 thanks to telemedicine. At Medgate Switzerland, more than 300 motivated employees \- including over 130 permanently employed doctors \- are actively shaping the medicine of tomorrow with the help of future\-oriented digital health solutions.  
Those who treat patients remotely at Medgate receive intensive training in telemedicine at the beginning. The medical guidelines developed for the needs of telemedicine and continuously refined over the years are practice\-oriented and designed for remote treatment. The patient management system supports doctors in their treatment by using artificial intelligence, among other things. This means that doctors have less administrative work and can focus more specifically on their patients. The medicine of the future is already a reality at Medgate.  
With flexible working models and reliable duty scheduling, Medgate makes it easy to combine work, leisure and family life.  
Data Engineer \- Analytics Platform (m/f/d)  
About the role  
At Medgate, data plays a key role in shaping the future of healthcare. As a Data Engineer, you'll design, build and operate our modern cloud data platform, enabling reliable insights for internal teams and customer\-facing solutions.  
You'll work with Azure Databricks, dbt and Power BI to transform data into valuable products while helping drive the evolution of our platform from a legacy Data Vault architecture to a modern dimensional (Kimball) model. Working closely with your team, you'll combine technical excellence with AI\-powered engineering practices to deliver scalable, high\-quality data solutions.  
Your tasks  
Design, build and operate scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Databricks (batch and streaming).  
Develop and maintain robust dimensional data models (Kimball) using dbt within a modern bronze/silver/gold medallion architecture.  
Create and maintain semantic models, dashboards and reports in Power BI for internal stakeholders and external customers.  
Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate data requirements into reliable and scalable technical solutions.  
Own your data products end\-to\-end, ensuring high quality, documentation, monitoring and operational excellence.  
Contribute to infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD processes and code reviews to continuously improve our platform.  
Ensure high standards of data quality, consistency and governance across all data products and pipelines, including the secure handling of sensitive data.  
Use AI tools such as as an integral part of your daily engineering workflow to accelerate development, improve quality and solve complex data challenges.  
Your profile  
Must have  
Fluent English and French (spoken and written). German is a strong advantage.  
5\+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a comparable role.  
Hands\-on experience with dbt and modern data transformation practices.  
Experience working with AI\-powered development tools (e.g. , ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot) to increase engineering productivity.  
Solid SQL skills and experience building reliable data pipelines.  
A degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.  
Nice to have  
Experience with Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory.  
Knowledge of dimensional data modelling (Kimball) and medallion architecture.  
Experience building semantic models, reports and DAX in Power BI.  
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.  
Experience with Unity Catalog or comparable data governance solutions.  
experience for data engineering or automation.  
Experience working with Data Vault environments.  
Experience deploying or supporting machine learning solutions in production.  
Experience in healthcare, insurance or other highly regulated industries.  
What we offer  
Work on meaningful projects that help shape the future of digital healthcare.  
Modern cloud\-native technology stack including Azure Databricks, dbt, Power BI and AI\-powered engineering tools.  
Hybrid working model with two office days per week (Tuesday and Wednesday) and flexible remote working on the remaining days.  
High level of ownership and the opportunity to actively shape our growing data platform.  
Collaborative, international working environment with short decision\-making paths.  
Continuous learning opportunities and access to modern technologies.

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Rheinfelden liegt im Kanton Aargau an der Grenze zu Südbaden und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung dank direkter Bahnverbindungen zu Basel, Zürich und Bern. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein ausgezeichnetes Angebot an Arbeitsplätzen in verschiedenen Branchen sowie eine hohe Lebensqualität mit schöner Naturlandschaft am Rhein. Dank moderner Infrastruktur und kurzer Pendlerstrecken ist Rheinfelden ein attraktiver Arbeitsort für Fachkräfte.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Rheinfelden

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: KJP Akutstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Rheinfelden verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH in der Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie ist in der Region Rheinfelden äußerst angespannt und bietet Ihnen hervorragende Chancen. - Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Vous assurez la prise en charge hospitalière et ambulatoire des patientes et patients suivis en soins aigus dans les secteurs de médecine et de chirurgie en garantissant une approche attentive, structurée et adaptée aux besoins individuels. Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des techniques d’entretien motivationnel, vous permettant d’accompagner efficacement la patientèle dans leurs changements de comportement.  
Vous avez déjà pris en charge des patients et patientes adultes dans des situations de soins aigus en médecine, en chirurgie ou dans des situations de maladies chroniques telles que l’obésité, le diabète ou les pathologies cardio\-vasculaires.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Berufsbildung 80-100% für die Region Sattel gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Sattel sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Berufsbildung.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Sattel – die Eckdaten Ihrer Stelle

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Berufsbildung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Sattel

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Sattel liegt malerisch in der Voralpenregion des Kantons Schwyz und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage zwischen Zürichsee und Zugersee. Die Gemeinde ist über die Hauptstrasse gut mit den umliegenden Wirtschaftszentren verbunden und bietet Ihnen kurze Pendlerzeiten in die Region Luzern und Zug. Als Arbeitsort zeichnet sich Sattel durch seine ruhige Atmosphäre, die naturnahe Umgebung und die hohe Lebensqualität aus, was es für berufstätige Menschen attraktiv macht.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Sattel an

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

- Zwingend für diese Stelle: Idealerweise Erfahrung als Berufsbildner/-in

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Berufsbildung

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Stelle liegt in der Berufsbildung: Sie begleiten Lernende durch ihre Ausbildung, planen Lernangebote und nehmen Qualifikationen ab. Denn wer Nachwuchs stark macht, prägt die Pflege von morgen. Didaktisches Flair ist hier ebenso gefragt wie Fachkompetenz.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Sattel verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachfrauen und -männer in der Region Sattel ist geprägt durch eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Fachkräften in Spitälern, Pflegeheimen und Ambulatorien. Sie profitieren als ausgebildete Fachperson von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem lokalen Arbeitsmarkt, da der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen fortbesteht. iPersonal als spezialisierter Personalvermittler erleichtert Ihnen den beruflichen Einstieg durch sein umfassendes Netzwerk zu regionalen Arbeitgebern, individuelle Betreuung und die Vermittlung von Positionen, die zu Ihren Anforderungen und Ihrer gewünschten Pensenregelung passen.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Sattel

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Sattel

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Sattel wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Sattel. Wir vermitteln schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

Quelle que soit leur fonction, les professionnel·le·s de la Fondation Saphir, ont une volonté commune, celle d’accompagner les Personnes au quotidien pour leur permettre d’expérimenter concrètement la stratégie institutionnelle de prestations « comme à la maison ». description:
La Fondation Saphir, fondation multi\-missions et multi\-sites (psyc  
Éducateur·trice social·e ES/HES ou Infirmier\-ère (F/H/D) En CDM de 6 mois entre 60% et 90% \- EPSM La Colombière  
La Fondation Saphir, fondation multi\-missions et multi\-sites (psychogériatrie, gériatrie, psychiatrie adulte), est active dans le domaine médico\-social dans le canton de Vaud et dans l’accueil et l’accompagnement de personnes fragilisées dans leur intégrité physique et psychique au cours de leur processus de vie.  
Afin de compléter notre équipe d’accompagnement, nous recherchons pour notre établissement à Hermenches, qui accueille 15 Personnes et qui est spécialisé dans le domaine de la psychiatrie adulte, le profil suivant :  
Éducateur·trice social·e ES/HES ou Infirmier\-ère (F/H/D) En CDM de 6 mois entre 60% et 90% \- EPSM La Colombière  
Quelle que soit leur fonction, les professionnel·le·s de la Fondation Saphir, ont une volonté commune, celle d’accompagner les Personnes au quotidien pour leur permettre d’expérimenter concrètement la stratégie institutionnelle de prestations « comme à la maison ». C’est\-à\-dire, conserver leurs habitudes autant que possible, offrir une réponse adaptée à leurs souhaits et, par le biais d’une réelle collaboration interprofessionnelle, permettre le bien\-être et le bonheur des Personnes.  
Au sein de notre établissement, vous accompagnez des Personnes adultes présentant des troubles psychiques, en tenant compte de leurs besoins, de leurs ressources et de leur projet d’accompagnement. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement sécurisant, stimulant et bienveillant, favorisant leur autonomie, leur participation et leur qualité de vie.  
Dans le cadre d'un accompagnement individualisé, ce poste est dédié au suivi d'une Personne présentant un trouble du spectre de l'autisme (TSA) ainsi qu’un retard mental léger. Vous jouez un rôle central dans son accueil, son intégration au sein de l'établissement et son accompagnement au quotidien, en veillant à créer un environnement sécurisant, structurant et adapté à ses besoins. Vous favorisez son autonomie, son inclusion et son bien\-être, en collaboration étroite avec l'équipe interprofessionnelle.  
En tant qu'éducateur·trice social·e ES/HES ou Infirmier·ère, vous participez à l'élaboration, à la mise en œuvre et au suivi du projet d'accompagnement individualisé. Vous adaptez vos interventions aux besoins de la Personne, assurez un suivi régulier de son évolution et contribuez à la coordination des actions avec les différent·e·s professionnel·le·s impliqué·e·s.  
VOTRE PARCOURS \- VOS QUALITÉS ET COMPÉTENCES  
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'éducateur·trice social·e ES/HES ou d'Infirmier·ère HES.  
• Vous possédez une expérience dans l'accompagnement de Personnes présentant un trouble du spectre de l'autisme (TSA).  
• Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour l'accompagnement de Personnes vivant avec des troubles psychiques en psychiatrie adulte.  
• Vous faites preuve d'empathie, de patience et d'une attitude centrée sur les besoins et les ressources de la Personne.  
• Vous avez le sens de l'organisation, des responsabilités et appréciez le travail en équipe interprofessionnelle.  
• Vous êtes capable de créer une relation de confiance et d'assurer un accompagnement individualisé dans la durée.  
• Vous êtes flexible, capable de vous adapter à des situations variées et de faire preuve d'initiative.  
• Vous maîtrisez le français (oral et écrit) ainsi que les outils informatiques usuels.  
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un permis de conduire valide.  
NOUS VOUS OFFRONS  
La possibilité de travailler dans un environnement riche de contacts et de relations humaines.  
L’occasion de participer à des projets institutionnels novateurs.  
Des conditions de travail et salariales selon la CCT SAN (convention collective de travail du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois). Classe 17\-19 et selon expérience.  
L’opportunité de maintenir et développer vos compétences grâce à un programme de formations internes variées.

1er septembre 2026

title: MSAT Product and Process Science Engineer
description:
MSAT Product and Process Science Engineer
-----------------------------------------

Roche Schweiz bridges the gap between pharmacy and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our longtime client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for an:

**MSAT Product and Process Science Engineer 80-100%**
=====================================================

**Background:**

The Manufacturing Science \& Technology Team (MSAT) is working in an agile framework. We are shaping and continuously improving the manufacturing of highly integrated sensors and cartridges (S\&C). Our service scope starts with input to first concept ideas, continues through a fast and effective design transfer from development into routine manufacturing, and finally ensures a robust and sustainable product care phase over the entire lifecycle.

Organized in Sub-Networks, Squads are the heart of our agile organization, supported by competencies organized in chapters. This fluid structure enables us to adapt quickly to changing priorities and support the dynamic needs within the S\&C organization. We foster agile ways of working and build trust as strategic business partners, actively working to break down silos by driving partnership and inclusive collaboration inside and outside of operations.

We are dedicated to mutual mentorship and continuous learning, empowering every team member to develop their capabilities and contribute meaningfully to the team and the wider organization. Our approach is to solve complexity by combining unique expertise with data-driven insights, implementing standardized digital solutions, and embracing new technologies. In all our efforts, we ensure we uphold our commitments to each other and our core values: Courage, Transparency, Open-Mindedness, and Can Do Attitude. This dedicated teamwork ultimately leads to developing and producing highly integrated, quality S\&C products that effectively serve our customers' needs throughout the entire lifecycle.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Taking responsibility for regular product care activities within the Squad, such as handling non-conformity notifications, leading investigations and root cause analysis, coordinating corrective actions in the manufacturing process, implementing changes to the process.
* Working according to internal processes defined by GxP-regulated environment.
* Monitoring production data and analyzing key production performance indicators.
* Driving continuous improvement initiations within the sensor production process.
* Supporting production operators as an SME on the ramp-up of newly established production lines.
* Planning and executing experiments (DoEs) in laboratory and production environments for investigation and product improvements.
* Coordination and collaboration with internal and external partners.

**Must Haves:**

* University Degree in (Electro-, Analytical- or Technical) Chemistry, (Chemical-, Process- or Manufacturing) Engineering, or a related field.
* First experience in a highly regulated production environment.
* First experience with GxP.
* Adaptive and autonomous team player with the ability for self-reflection.
* Open and solution-oriented mindset that actively fosters collaboration.
* Interest in agile methodologies and project management techniques.
* Thinking strategically and setting concrete objectives with an entrepreneurial mindset.
* Experience with statistical analysis / data science.
* Ability to apply a programming language (e.g., Python or R-Studio) in a practical setting.
* Fluent in English, German at least B2 level.

**Nice to Have:**

* Professional experience in a highly regulated industry, ideally in the pharmaceutical or medical sector.
* Knowledge of Six Sigma and/or lean methodology.
* Previous experience in an agile framework (Agile Team, Scrum, Kanban, etc.) and/or project management.
* Knowledge of chemical lab processes or manufacturing (screen printing, dispensing) processes.
* Database handling (SQL, Snowflake) and experience with software projects.

**What we offer:**

* A chance to contribute to one of the most significant pharmaceutical companies in the world.
* A modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas.
* Central location with highway access and train station nearby.
* Diversified activity profile.
* Home office possibilities.
* Further training opportunities through temptraining.
* Participation in a dynamic and motivated team.
* Good compensation.

Please send your complete application documents to Mr. Severin Räfle.

description:
Rejoindre Assura, c’est évoluer dans un environnement  
Négociatrice ou négociateur  
Rejoindre Assura, c’est évoluer dans un environnement collaboratif et dynamique où chacun joue un rôle essentiel et contribue à une mission qui fait sens. Chaque jour, nous mettons notre énergie et notre expertise au service de nos clients, pour les accompagner dans leurs décisions de santé  
Envie de nous rejoindre ? Alors, nice to meet you !  
Négociatrice ou négociateur  
Au sein de notre équipe dédiée à la négociation des conventions LAMal et LCA avec les fournisseurs de soins, tu occupes un rôle clé en pilotant chaque jour les échanges avec nos partenaires, prestataires et établissements de santé. Ton objectif ? Obtenir des accords équilibrés et durables, dans le respect du cadre légal et des enjeux économiques, tout en veillant à préserver une relation de confiance avec nos interlocuteurs. Grâce à ton expertise, tu contribues directement à optimiser les coûts et à garantir des solutions justes et cohérentes pour nos assurés .  
Ce que tu fais au quotidien  
Tu es responsable des négociations et de la contractualisation avec les fournisseurs de soins dans les cantons et/ou régions dédiés. À ce titre, tu mènes les négociations tarifaires ainsi que celles portant sur les textes conventionnels et tu représentes Assura au sein des commissions et groupes de travail des associations faîtières, en contribuant activement aux évolutions du cadre sectoriel.

title: Director of Innovation Management & Strategy
description:
In short
Join On’s Footwear Innovation team as the Director of Innovation Management, where you will lead a dynamic group of technology-affine business developers and technical project managers. Your mission will be to amplify the impact of product innovation by strategically managing the innovation portfolio, process, and long-term vision. This role focuses on leading the Innovation Management team, driving active visioning and strategy creation, and ensuring that our innovation initiatives—from "Big Bets" to our iconic technology franchises—are translated into impactful realities for On.

We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Director of Innovation Management to lead a critical function within our Innovation department. This role is pivotal in ensuring our innovation efforts are strategically focused, efficiently executed, and prioritized across the organization. You will lead a team of talented professionals to maximize the impact of innovation at On, utilizing a strong foundational understanding of technology and material science to guide the strategic direction of our portfolio and technology brand franchises.

Your Mission

Strategic Leadership:
- Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for Innovation Management, including active visioning and strategy creation, aligning with On's overarching business objectives.
- Lead and mentor the Innovation Management team, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
- Drive a culture of continuous improvement in innovation processes and strategic portfolio alignment.
- Act as the primary link between Innovation and the rest of the company to ensure strategic cohesion.

Innovation Management Leadership:
- Ensure Innovation initiatives are strategically aligned with On's overall goals and priorities.
- Oversee the management of the Innovation Portfolio, including prioritization, resource allocation, and progress tracking.
- Serve as the PMO for "Big Bet" Innovation projects, ensuring high-impact initiatives are executed with excellence.
- Lead the continuous improvement and operational excellence of the end-to-end innovation process.
- Develop and implement frameworks and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of innovation activities.

Strategic Technology Alignment:
- Manage specific tech brand franchises and oversee the technology roll-out for key innovations such as Superfoam, CloudTec®, and New Propulsion Tech.
- Ensure the successful identification and evaluation of new technologies and materials that provide a competitive advantage.
- Oversee the strategic technology roadmap, ensuring workstreams are prioritized based on strategic alignment and potential impact.
- Collaborate with all technical teams to ensure a smooth horizontal transition of innovations into the product organization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Work closely with all teams in the product organization to ensure alignment and effective collaboration on innovation initiatives.
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels regarding the innovation portfolio, processes, and technology roadmap.
- Manage budgets and resources effectively, ensuring optimal utilization.

Your story
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field.
- Proven track record of leadership for +10 years in an innovation management or product strategy function, preferably within the sportswear or a similar consumer-facing industry.
- Strong foundational understanding of technologies and material science to effectively evaluate innovation potential and manage tech franchises.
- Deep understanding of innovation processes, portfolio management, and operational excellence principles.
- Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams and drive strategic visioning.
- Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
- A strong interest in sports, technology, sustainability, and innovation.

About the Team
The Innovation team is responsible for On’s future products, out-of-the-box thinking and athlete-informed technology that differentiates On’s products in the market to become the most premium global sportswear brand, built on performance, design and impact. Within the Innovation team, you will lead two highly motivated and skilled teams: Innovation Management and Technology Management. The Innovation Management team focuses on the strategic alignment of innovation initiatives, the effective management of our innovation portfolio, and the continuous improvement of our innovation processes. The Technology Management team is responsible for the successful scaling, implementation, and continuous evolution of our key technologies, ensuring that strategic technology initiatives are driven forward effectively. Together, these teams are crucial in translating bold ideas into impactful realities for On.

title: Laboratory Manager
description:
The Quake Laboratory is being established at ETH Zürich in 2026 by Stephen Quake, who is moving from Stanford University. The lab works at the interface of physics, engineering, and biology, developing new measurement and modelling approaches that transform what is possible to learn from individual cells and from minute amounts of molecular material.

Three major research programmes will run in parallel: (1) reconstructing the regulatory architecture of E. coli at high resolution as a foundation for predictive models of gene regulation; (2) building large-scale single-cell atlases of human and model-organism tissues — including a first-of-its-kind atlas of the human autonomic nervous system — and training AI/foundation models on those atlases to interrogate aging biology and the evolution of multicellularity; and (3) advancing liquid-biopsy approaches that read cell-free nucleic acids from blood to detect disease, monitor physiology in collaboration with external partners.

The lab will be a multidisciplinary environment of approximately 10 people spanning molecular biologists, biochemists, computational biologists, machine-learning researchers, physicists, and engineers, with active collaborations across ETH, EPFL, the University of Zürich, and internationally.

The Laboratory Manager is the operational backbone of the group. You will own the day-to-day functioning of a complex, multi-modal wet lab — from bacterial molecular biology through human clinical sample processing through high-throughput sequencing — while serving as senior bench scientist, trainer, and trusted adviser to the PI on everything that keeps a productive research group running.

This role is ideal for an experienced research scientist who enjoys working across multiple biological systems, building infrastructure, mentoring less experienced colleagues, and taking pride in operational excellence. You will not be expected to drive a separate independent research programme; rather, you will enable and accelerate everyone else's. In return, you will be a core, named contributor on ambitious science, with a genuine voice in how the lab is built.

Lab operations and infrastructure

Lead the build-out and ongoing operation of the lab's wet-bench facilities at ETH, including equipment selection, installation, qualification, and routine maintenance contracts
Establish and maintain shared resources: cell culture rooms, BSL-2 areas, sequencing prep zones, –80 °C and liquid-nitrogen storage, autoclaves, common reagent stocks, and instrument calendars
Own ordering, supplier relationships, inventory management, and stockroom organisation across consumables and reagents; negotiate framework agreements where useful
Maintain and audit core SOPs, sample-tracking systems, and electronic lab notebook practices across the group
Serve as the lab's interface with ETH core facilities (e.g., Functional Genomics Center Zurich, ScopeM, Genome Engineering & Measurement Lab) and external service providers
Bacterial molecular biology and biochemistry — E. coli regulome

Run and oversee a molecular cloning pipeline for E. coli — design and assembly of plasmids and genome-integrated constructs, strain construction, and storage
Set up and maintain biochemical workflows relevant to regulatory studies: protein expression and purification, in vitro transcription, and quantitative biochemistry as projects require
Establish microbial growth, induction, and time-course infrastructure, including plate readers, continuous-culture systems, and microfluidics interfaces where relevant
Train new lab members in fundamental microbiology, sterile technique, and standard E. coli genetics; troubleshoot stuck cloning and expression projects
Mammalian cell biology and tissue handling — single-cell atlases

Run and supervise mammalian cell culture (primary cells, iPSC-derived cells, established lines), including media preparation, line authentication, and biobanking
Establish robust workflows for tissue dissociation, single-cell and single-nucleus suspension preparation, FACS-based cell sorting, and quality assessment
Coordinate the tissue-acquisition pipeline with clinical and academic partners — biospecimen agreements, chain-of-custody documentation, fixation and shipping logistics, ethics-approved sample handling
Liquid biopsy and cell-free nucleic acid workflows

Operate and maintain low-input cfDNA and cfRNA extraction workflows
Implement and refine cfNA library-preparation protocols (small-input WGS, methylation/EM-seq, fragmentomics, targeted panels, cfRNA-seq) and contribute to method development for new assay modalities
Establish quality-management practices appropriate to clinical-grade samples
High-throughput sequencing

Serve as the lab's senior practitioner for sequencing workflows— including library QC, pooling, balancing, and instrument operation or vendor coordination
Establish QC dashboards and acceptance criteria across library types (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA/ATAC, spatial, cfDNA/cfRNA, microbial)
Coordinate with computational team members on sample sheets, demultiplexing, primary QC, and timely return of FASTQs and standard metrics
Maintain relationships with the Functional Genomics Center Zurich and external sequencing providers to handle overflow and specialty platforms
People, training, and culture

Onboard new lab members (postdocs, PhD and MSc students, technicians, visitors); design and deliver hands-on training in core methods
Mentor junior research staff and rotation students at the bench; lead routine technical lab meetings and troubleshooting clinics
Foster a rigorous, collaborative, and psychologically safe lab culture; embody and reinforce expectations around reproducibility, careful record-keeping, and intellectual honesty
Compliance, safety, and ethics

Serve as the lab's biosafety officer and primary point of contact for ETH Safety, Security, Health & Environment (SGU); maintain BSL-1/BSL-2 documentation, GMO and pathogen registrations as applicable
Ensure compliance with Swiss regulations on the use of human biological samples and personal data (Human Research Act, Federal Act on Data Protection), including ethics submissions and amendments
Manage chemical inventory, waste streams, radiation safety (where applicable), and animal-work documentation in coordination with ETH veterinary services
Lead the lab's emergency-preparedness procedures and serve as first responder for incidents
Desired Qualifications

Education: PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, genomics, or a closely related field; or a Master's degree with substantial additional research experience
Bench experience: At least 5 years of hands-on experience post-degree in a research lab, with demonstrable senior-level expertise across at least two of the three core areas (bacterial molecular biology / mammalian single-cell genomics / cell-free nucleic acid workflows)
Bacterial cloning and biochemistry: Independent experience designing and executing E. coli cloning, strain engineering, and protein biochemistry without supervision
Mammalian cell biology: Fluency in primary and cultured mammalian cell handling, FACS, and tissue dissociation for single-cell genomics
Sequencing: Direct experience preparing and QC'ing libraries for Illumina sequencing; familiarity with at least one long-read platform (ONT or PacBio) is a strong advantage
Liquid biopsy / cfNA: Demonstrated experience processing blood for cell-free nucleic acids and the pre-analytical care this requires
Lab leadership: Track record of training and supervising more junior scientists; ability to write clear SOPs and run a cross-functional bench operation
Operational competence: Comfortable with budgets, ordering systems, equipment service contracts, and biosafety documentation
Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; ability to interact effectively with clinicians, vendors, ETH administration, and external collaborators
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with single-cell genomics platforms (10x Genomics, Parse, Scale, Honeycomb) and spatial transcriptomics
Experience with clinical or biobank sample workflows under ISO 15189 / ISO 20387 or equivalent quality systems
Experience with Swiss research administration, ETH systems, or comparable European institutions
German language skills
A senior, intellectually central position in one of the most productive single-cell and measurement-science groups in the world as it moves from Stanford to ETH
Competitive ETH salary and benefits, commensurate with experience and ETH guidelines
A multi-year horizon: this is intended as a long-term role, not a stepping stone
Substantial influence on lab design, equipment selection, and operational standards
Co-authorship on publications you materially contribute to, in line with established practice
Professional development support, including conference travel and technical training
